title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms.
notes: 这篇论文提出了 Transformer 架构，是现代 NLP 的基础

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text.
notes: BERT 通过预训练任务学习双向上下文表示

title: GPT-3: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract: We demonstrate that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance, sometimes even reaching competitiveness with prior state-of-the-art fine-tuning approaches.
notes: GPT-3 展示了大语言模型的 few-shot 学习能力

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously.
notes: ResNet 通过残差连接解决了深度网络训练问题

title: Generative Adversarial Nets
abstract: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process, in which we simultaneously train two models: a generative model G that captures the data distribution, and a discriminative model D that estimates the probability that a sample came from the training data rather than G.
notes: GAN 通过对抗训练生成逼真数据

title: Vector Search with seekdb
abstract: seekdb provides hybrid search capabilities combining vector search, full-text search, and structured queries. This document explores how seekdb can be used for semantic retrieval in research applications.
notes: seekdb 支持向量、全文和结构化混合检索

title: PowerContext: Context Management for AI Agents
abstract: PowerContext is an open-source context service for AI agents, supporting HTTP API, MCP, and Python SDK. It enables memory and context management across multiple interactions.
notes: PowerContext 为 AI Agent 提供上下文和记忆管理
